hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(tsx|ts)$' && ! echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'node_modules|\.d\.ts$'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30 || true; fi

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm -rf /|DROP TABLE|git push --force|git reset --hard HEAD~[2-9]|DELETE FROM|TRUNCATE'; then echo 'Blocked: destructive command requires manual confirmation' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.env(\.local|\.production)?$'; then echo 'Blocked: direct .env file edits are not allowed — update .env.example and remind the user to update .env.local manually' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); COMMIT=$(git log -1 --format='%s' 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); echo "{\"additionalContext\": \"Git branch: $BRANCH | Last commit: $COMMIT\"}"

INPUT=$(cat); if [ "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active' 2>/dev/null)" = 'true' ]; then exit 0; fi; echo 'Reminder: if you changed application code, run /wrap to update SESSION_CONTEXT.md and commit.' >&2; exit 0
